ABOUT THE LAB

Curiosity, rendered.

Spatial is a collection of interactive experiments in three dimensions. Every shape is generated live from points and mathematics.

Drag to find a new perspective, adjust the controls, or simply watch things unfold. Use arrow keys on the canvas to rotate, and + or − to zoom.
